title: Gas-phase aldol condensation of formaldehyde to produce hydroxyacetaldehyde and its implication to new particle formation: a theoretical study
content:
RSC Adv., 2024, 14,38222-38231
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA08063G, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Nianchi Tang, Lijuan Zhang, Jiao Chen, Yue Pan, Hongyang Xu, Chunyu Wang
Atmospheric CH2O aldol condensation catalyzed by H2SO4 is greatly enhanced at 200–298 K and the particle formation rates (J) in the H2SO4–C2H4O2 system exceed those in the H2SO4–H2O system under low ambient H2SO4 concentrations.
